bio.text: Scott Meyers is the Republican candidate for California's 30th Congressional District in 2026.
Meyers graduated from Simi Valley High School and earned a law degree from Pepperdine University School of Law in 1988, and has worked as an attorney.
According to the candidate statement, Meyers is a California native, has been self-employed for 26 years and has built a law practice over three decades.
